content.title: When does Rory McIlroy tee off today? 2026 Masters Round 4 schedule, tee times
content.text: When does Rory McIlroy tee off today? 2026 Masters Round 4 schedule, tee timesFollow along with live updates of all the final-round action at the Masters Tournament.Rory McIlroy got his long-awaited, hard-earned breakthrough at Augusta National Golf Club last year when he won his first-ever Masters and completed the career Grand Slam.AdvertisementThis year, he’s looking to make a different kind of history.REQUIRED READING: Masters leaderboard, tee times, live updates, how to watch final roundMcIlroy enters the final round of the Masters tied with Cameron Young for the lead at 11-under par. Should he pull out the victory Sunday, McIlroy would become only the fourth golfer ever to win the Masters in back-to-back years.McIlroy had been in a much more enviable position 24 hours earlier, with a 6-stroke lead after the second round, the largest 36-hole lead in Masters history.AdvertisementHere’s what you need to know about McIlroy heading into his final round at the Masters:1 / 40Rory McIlroy let 6‑stroke Masters lead slip away, still co‑leaderThe weekend arrives with the leaderboard tightening and pressure rising at Augusta National.These images follow Rory McIlroy as he begins Saturday in the hunt at the Masters.Above, Rory McIlroy of Northern Ireland lines up a putt on the 14th green during the third round of the 2026 Masters Tournament at Augusta National Golf Club on April 11, 2026, in Augusta, Georgia.2 / 40Rory McIlroy let 6‑stroke Masters lead slip away, still co‑leaderRory McIlroy tees off on the fourth hole during the third round of the Masters Tournament at Augusta National Golf Club.40 / 40Rory McIlroy let 6‑stroke Masters lead slip away, still co‑leaderRory McIlroy of Northern Ireland looks on from the 15th green during the third round of the 2026 Masters Tournament at Augusta National Golf Club on April 11, 2026, in Augusta, Georgia.McIlroy is scheduled to tee off at 2:25 p.m. ET at Augusta National Golf Club.He’ll be playing in a two-person group with Cameron Young, with whom he’s tied for the 54-hole lead.Masters leaderboardRory McIlroy and Cameron Young are tied atop the leaderboard at the Masters, with both at 11-under par. Sam Burns is one stroke behind them, at 10-under, while Shane Lowry is in fourth place at 9-under.AdvertisementHere’s a look at the top 10 of the leaderboard at the Masters and accompanying tee times:All times EasternT-1.
